from alembic.config import Config

from eva.adapters.model.pydantic_conversation import PydanticConversationModel

from eva.contracts.memory import MemoryRecall
from eva.contracts.canonical_json import canonical_sha256
from eva.application.orchestration import ToolDispatchResult, ToolProofObservation
from eva.bootstrap.runtime import PostgresHindsightMemoryRuntime

ROOT=Path('/tmp/eva2-tl001/real-model')
ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
DSN='postgresql+psycopg://postgres@/eva2_living_disposable_tl001_real_20260908?host=/tmp/eva2-co006-memory.JxnTze/pgsocket'
engine=sa.create_engine(DSN)
config=Config('alembic.ini');config.set_main_option('sqlalchemy.url',DSN)
_upgrade(engine,config)
class Memory:
 def recall_for_presence(self,q):
  return PresenceMemory(MemoryRecall(schema_version=1,contract='MemoryRecall/v1',
   recall_id=q.recall_id,query_purpose=q.query_purpose,tenant_id=q.tenant_id,
   principal_id=q.principal_id,conversation_id=q.conversation_id,project_id=q.project_id,
   requested_valid_at=q.requested_valid_at,admitted_fact_ids_sha256=canonical_sha256([]),
   selected=[],excluded_reasons={},projection_version='probe',
   scope_sha256=canonical_sha256(q.scope),created_at=q.requested_valid_at),())
reports=[]
try:
 for index in range(3):
  node='kast_'+secrets.token_hex(5); answer='gezinscode-'+secrets.token_hex(7)
  name='lees_document_'+secrets.token_hex(4)
  directory=ROOT/str(index);directory.mkdir()
  documents={'start':{'volgend_document':node},node:{'gezochte_code':answer}}
  for key,value in documents.items():
   (directory/(key+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(value))
  descriptor=ConversationToolDescriptor(name=name,
   description='Lees een lokaal testdocument op sleutel. Begin bij start. Een document kan met volgend_document verwijzen naar een ander document. De inhoud komt onder document terug.',
   input_schema={'type':'object','properties':{'sleutel':{'type':'string'}},'required':['sleutel'],'additionalProperties':False})
  calls=[]; observations=[]
  class Planner:
   action_names=(name,)
   async def prepare(self,turn,call):
    assert set(call.arguments)=={'sleutel'}
    key=call.arguments['sleutel']
    if key not in documents: raise ValueError('unknown document')
    return ConversationToolPreparation(tool_name='probe.read_document',arguments={'sleutel':key},
     expected_proof={'sleutel':key},receipt_output={},observation_output_key='document')
  class Provider:
   async def execute(self,request):
    key=request.arguments['sleutel']; json.loads((directory/(key+'.json')).read_text())
    calls.append({'key':key,'operation_id':request.operation_id})
    return ToolDispatchResult(True,request.operation_id,{})
   async def observe(self,request,dispatch):
    key=request.arguments['sleutel']; path=directory/(key+'.json')
    raw=path.read_bytes(); observations.append({'key':key,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
    return ToolProofObservation('verified',{'sleutel':key,**json.loads(raw)},
     {'source':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
  model=PydanticConversationModel(auth_file=Path('/var/lib/eva2/managed-b-slot3/model-access-lease/auth.json'),
   conversation_tools=(descriptor,),timeout_seconds=60)
  external=PostgresExternalConversationTools(engine,Planner(),Provider())
  runtime=object.__new__(PostgresHindsightMemoryRuntime)
  runtime._engine=engine;runtime._runtime_tenant_id='tl001-real';runtime._runtime_installation_id='probe'
  runtime._conversation=LivingConversation(Memory(),model,
   IdentityProfile('Eva','Warme en praktische digitale huisgenoot.',('Gebruik toolresultaten als bewijs.',),80),
   PostgresConversationActions(engine,external_tools=(external,)))
  turn=ConversationTurn.private('tl001-real','probe','test-owner','probe-chat',f'probe:{index}',
   'Zoek de gezochte code met de beschikbare documenttool. Begin bij start en volg de verwijzing. Geef de code exact terug.',
   datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z'))
  before=time.monotonic()
  try:
   reply=runtime.respond(turn)
   elapsed=time.monotonic()-before
   independent=json.loads((directory/(node+'.json')).read_text())['gezochte_code']
   prior=list(calls)
   replay=runtime.respond(turn)
   passed=(independent in reply.text and [x['key'] for x in calls]==['start',node]
     and replay==reply and calls==prior)
   record={'trial':index,'passed':passed,'toolName':name,'reply':reply.text,'usage':reply.model_usage.to_wire(),
    'seconds':elapsed,'calls':calls,'observations':observations,'expectedAnswer':independent,'replayEqual':replay==reply}
  except Exception as error:
   record={'trial':index,'passed':False,'errorType':type(error).__name__,
    'error':str(error),'calls':calls,'observations':observations}
  reports.append(record)
  (ROOT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
  print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
  if not record['passed']: break
finally:
 engine.dispose()
